snippet.title: My Idle Witch - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302490/My_Idle_Witch/

Excited to share My Idle Witch, a solo project I’ve been working on for the past few months 🧙‍♀️  
A cozy idle desktop companion where you brew potions, customize your witch and her workshop, and stay productive with integrated tools.  

Full release planned for late March!
